column1: # Module 07 — data taster (Hevy). Format: Text<TAB>tags. Card law: anki/CARD-RULES.md
A venv = {{c1::a private Python + packages inside the project folder}} — delete the folder, it's gone.
DataFrame = {{c1::a table}}; Series = {{c2::one typed, labelled column}}.
Tidy data = {{c1::one row per observation}} — every question becomes filter/group over rows.
Almost never loop in pandas — operate {{c1::column-at-a-time}}: df["volume"] = df["weight_kg"] * df["reps"]
Filter rows for one exercise: {{c1::df[df["exercise"] == "Bench Press (Barbell)"]}} — a boolean mask.
ISO week key from dates: {{c1::df["date"].dt.isocalendar()}} → year + zero-padded week.
Epley est-1RM: {{c1::weight × (1 + reps/30)}} — per set, take the max.
Copy the data file before analysing: {{c1::read-only law}} + {{c2::a re-run on the copy = reproducibility check}}.
Warm-ups in volume? is {{c1::a tidying DECISION — either answer fine, must be written down}}.
Module 07 in four words: {{c1::data → honest sentence → decision}}.
